units.source_text: 且说髭黑大将在玉鬘那里，闻知式部卿亲王把女儿接回的消息，

en.t: Now, while the Higekuro General was at Tamakazura's residence, he heard that Prince Shikibukyo had taken his daughter back,

units.source_text: 倒像个年轻妻子，打翻醋瓶，回娘家去。

en.t: It is just like a young wife getting jealous and going back to her parents' home.

units.source_text: 她本人并无决心，不会断然出此；

en.t: She herself has no such resolve, and would never take such a step so decisively;
the prince has acted rashly instead."

units.source_text: 他想起家中子女，以及外人议论，心绪很不安宁，

en.t: Thinking of the children at home and of what outsiders would say, he became deeply unsettled,

units.source_text: 便对玉鬘说道：“我家里出了这样的怪事呢。

en.t: and said to Tamakazura, "Such a strange thing has happened in my household.
With her gone, we may actually be more at ease.

units.source_text: 其实这个人脾气甚好，将来你去了，

en.t: In truth, she has a very gentle nature, and when you go there in the future,

units.source_text: 她会躲在一个角落里，决不与你为难。

en.t: she will hide away in a corner and will certainly not make things difficult for you.

units.source_text: 可是她的父亲突然把她接了去。

en.t: But her father suddenly came and took her away.

units.source_text: 外人闻知此事，定将怪我薄情，

en.t: When people hear of this, they will surely blame me for being heartless,

units.source_text: 故我须去说个明白，马上就回来。”

en.t: so I must go and explain things clearly, and I will return at once."

units.source_text: 他身穿一件华美的外衣，内穿白面蓝里衬衣和宝蓝色花绸裙，

en.t: He wore a splendid outer robe, with a white garment lined in blue underneath and a floral silk skirt in deep royal blue,
and both his attire and his appearance were imposing.

units.source_text: 侍女们觉得此人与玉鬘非常相称。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting felt that he and Tamakazura made a very fitting pair.

units.source_text: 但玉鬘闻知他家里有此种事情，痛惜自身命苦，对他看也不看一眼。

en.t: But when Tamakazura heard of such affairs in his household, she lamented her own unhappy fate and would not even glance at him.
